script:
{ a[1/0]=7; echo same; } 2>/dev/null
echo next:$?

{ set -e; f(){ (exit 7); a[1/0]=7; echo body; }; if f; then echo yes; else echo no; fi; echo after; } 2>/dev/null
echo next:$?

{ set -e; declare -n r=t; f(){ (exit 7); for r in bad-name; do echo body; done; echo function:$?; }; if f; then echo yes; else echo no; fi; echo after; } 2>/dev/null
echo next:$?

{ eval 'a[1/0]=7; echo inner
echo inner-next'; echo after:$?; } 2>/dev/null
echo next:$?

{ printf "%s\n" "a[1/0]=7; echo inner" "echo inner-next" >input.sh; . ./input.sh; echo after:$?; } 2>/dev/null
echo next:$?

{ declare -i x; x=1/0; echo same; } 2>/dev/null
echo next:$?

{ set -e; declare -i x; f(){ (exit 7); x=1/0; echo body; }; if f; then echo yes; else echo no; fi; echo after; } 2>/dev/null
echo next:$?
trap '{ a[1/0]=7; echo trap-body; } 2>/dev/null' EXIT; exit 3
readonly x=0; trap '{ a[x++]=7; echo trap-body; } 2>/dev/null' EXIT; exit 3
{ readonly x=0; trap 'echo fn:${FUNCNAME[*]}; declare -p localv 2>/dev/null || echo no-local' EXIT; f(){ local localv=secret; a[x++]=7; }; f; } 2>/dev/null

{ set -o posix; a[1/0]=7; echo same; } 2>/dev/null
echo next:$?

{ set -o posix; set -e; f(){ (exit 7); a[1/0]=7; echo body; }; if f; then echo yes; else echo no; fi; echo after; } 2>/dev/null
echo next:$?

{ set -o posix; set -e; declare -n r=t; f(){ (exit 7); for r in bad-name; do echo body; done; echo function:$?; }; if f; then echo yes; else echo no; fi; echo after; } 2>/dev/null
echo next:$?

{ set -o posix; eval 'a[1/0]=7; echo inner
echo inner-next'; echo after:$?; } 2>/dev/null
echo next:$?

{ set -o posix; printf "%s\n" "a[1/0]=7; echo inner" "echo inner-next" >input.sh; . ./input.sh; echo after:$?; } 2>/dev/null
echo next:$?

{ set -o posix; declare -i x; x=1/0; echo same; } 2>/dev/null
echo next:$?

{ set -o posix; set -e; declare -i x; f(){ (exit 7); x=1/0; echo body; }; if f; then echo yes; else echo no; fi; echo after; } 2>/dev/null
echo next:$?
set -o posix; trap '{ a[1/0]=7; echo trap-body; } 2>/dev/null' EXIT; exit 3
set -o posix; readonly x=0; trap '{ a[x++]=7; echo trap-body; } 2>/dev/null' EXIT; exit 3
{ set -o posix; readonly x=0; trap 'echo fn:${FUNCNAME[*]}; declare -p localv 2>/dev/null || echo no-local' EXIT; f(){ local localv=secret; a[x++]=7; }; f; } 2>/dev/null
